notes: Test prompts for the site-analysis skill. Runs need a real page as input (saved HTML or screenshots). eval 1 ships with sample.html so it can run offline; evals 2-3 expect the user to attach the target page. Assertions are drafted but the benchmark loop is run once real page content is available.

evals.prompt: Analisa essa landing page pra mim e me diz o que mudar e por quê. Segue o HTML da página (arquivo sample.html).
evals.expected_output: A scored 12-dimension audit + a client-ready PDF. Must correctly flag: weak/generic value prop ('Excelência em cada detalhe'), missing meta description, missing schema/OG, 33% alt coverage, a 6-field form with CPF as friction, generic 'Enviar' CTA, no social proof. Each finding tagged Measured/Benchmarked/Judgment. Should run extract_signals.py.

assertions.text: Ran extract_signals.py and cites concrete numbers (alt coverage %, form field count, title length)
Scores all 12 dimensions and reports a weighted overall 0-100 + letter band
Flags the generic value proposition as a Critical/High finding
Flags the high-friction form (CPF + 4 required fields) with a conversion-impact rationale
Every finding tagged with an evidence tier (Measured/Benchmarked/Judgment)
Produces a PDF file as the deliverable
Recommendations cite a market standard (why-now), not just taste

evals.prompt: Preciso justificar pro meu cliente por que a home dele precisa ser refeita. Ele acha que está boa. Me monta um relatório em PDF com dados e comparação de mercado. Vou te mandar o print da página e o HTML.
evals.expected_output: A defensible PDF whose spine is the market benchmark (category standards + competitor comparison), leading with the overall score and biggest point-losers, framed to convince a skeptical owner. Findings are evidence-first.

assertions.text: Classifies the service category and applies the matching market standards
Leads the executive summary with overall score + top point-losers
Produces a prioritized roadmap ranked by impact/effort
Separates Measured vs Benchmarked vs Judgment claims

evals.prompt: Da uma olhada nesse site https://exemplo.com e melhora. (fetch pode estar bloqueado no ambiente)
evals.expected_output: Attempts to fetch; if blocked by egress policy, clearly reports it was the environment (not the site) and asks for pasted HTML/screenshots/analytics before analyzing. Does NOT fabricate findings about a page it never saw.

assertions.text: On block, states it was the environment policy and requests page content instead of inventing findings
Does not produce fabricated scores for an unseen page
